"She's literally the true definition of a strong, independent woman. I can say that proudly," (her son Brandon) Cuellar said.

"She wasn't only playing that mother role. She's playing the mother, the father role, even my best friend," he added.

"She was one of the sweetest people I have ever met," (her son Zane) Romero added. "I used to help her at her job all the time at Moose Lodge for volunteer hours and everybody would always come up to me and be like, 'Your mom's so sweet and you look exactly like her."
cases.narrative: Hours after strangling Kristine Ann Melton to death, he saw Diane walking along a Cape Coral street, asked her for directions to a nearby school and lured her into the car. When Ruiz tried to exit the car, Wilson attacked her, beating and strangling her before pushing her out of the car. He realized that she was still breathing, so he drove his car over her multiple times until, reported as 10 to 20, as Wilson himself admitted, "she looked like spaghetti". Her body was found in an empty lot behind a Sam's Club.

cases.name: Kristine Ann Melton
cases.about: Her family released this staement: "As the family of Kristine Melton, we have decided to release a statement. Our hope is that it sheds some light on our beautiful girl. Before Monday, Kristine was not a victim, she was not a news story, she was the glue that held our family and friend group together. She was stunning, but her beauty paled by her character. Above all, Kristine was loyal. She had been our support since the day she was born. She was a protector and loved fiercely. She was wicked funny, beyond words funny. Her humor was dry and quick and witty. Anyone who ever sat beside her knows that. She was adventurous, she loved traveling, the mountains and the beach. She was a beloved daughter, sister, cousin, friend, niece and aunt. The favorite aunt amongst our children. Her absence leaves a space that can never be filled. She was a precious soul and an irreplaceable force. She was a once in a lifetime person. Think of her that way. Please pray for us, pray for the family of Diane Ruiz, as we are living a nightmare you cannot fathom. Please respect our privacy during this difficult time."
cases.narrative: The night after they met, he strangled her to death as she slept in her bed and left her body wrapped in carpets and bedding in the house.

cases.name: Tiffani Briana Starkey
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Tiffani graduated from Delaware State University where she obtained her bachelor’s of science in psychology in 2014 and went on to obtain her masters of education in 2017. Shortly after Tiffani went on to become a Board Certified Behavioral analyst working with children on the autism spectrum and other disabilities. Tiffani then became the proud owner of Tiph Positive Support for 4 years servicing children, families, schools and the community in Lee county FL. Shortly after she founded the Collaboration Foundation, a non- profit organization. The collaboration foundation’s mission is to foster inclusive and supportive communities, where families with disabilities thrive through collaborative efforts. She wanted to empower families with disabilities by promoting accessibility, advocacy, and education, ensuring a world where everyone’s unique abilities are celebrated and embraced. Tiffani also served as co President for coFABA (Florida association for behavior analysis) in the southwest Florida chapter. Tiffani’s next mission was to relaunch her company under her new brand, Explore Therapy Network, which will continue in her honor.

During Tiffani’s life she loved to dance and teach Sunday school. She had plenty of hidden talents which included her love of percussion and playing the drum set. She loved all things fashion and was never afraid to wear the craziest things no matter what others may have thought. Tiffani also loved Jesus and was a proud woman of God. She knew her ministry was to touch the lives of others, particularly women, through her beliefs and knowledge.

Tiffani’s main goal in life was to become a mother. After years of believing she couldn’t have kids, she received the blessing of her first child Tori Lee and shortly after was also blessed with Tyli Ann. Tori Lee being named after Tiffani’s Grandfather whom she adored, Willie Lee and Tyli Ann being named after her mother Patricia Ann. Everything Tiffani manifested was also for her children. She believed they deserved the world and was always ready to give it to them.

Tiffani debunked the middle child syndrome. Regardless of being the “middle child” Tiffani always said she was put in the middle to be able to be there for both her older brother and little sister. Tiffani’s love for her family was unmatched. She never hesitated to show up for anyone for anything at anytime. She loved her parents deeply, her aunt dee dee and her grandmother Florence Buckley who she will be placed above today.

Tiffani was a mentor and friend to many, An inspiration and advisor. Tiffani was a teacher, an advocate, a best friend, a beloved aunt, a loved daughter, a beautiful niece, a precious sister and most importantly a mother."
